RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 30

Raising the panel’s gender without concrete evidence of bias will appear accusatory and can damage your professional reputation in a close-knit industry. A panel’s composition alone is not evidence of discrimination; panels typically reflect available senior staff and HR representatives. 

Furthermore, group head positions heavily prioritize business development, client management, and leadership vision over raw years of technical experience—qualities specifically highlighted in the announcement. A two-week delay for written feedback is also typical corporate turnaround, not an admission of wrongdoing. 

Instead of alleging bias, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback on how you can strengthen your commercial and client-facing profile for future leadership opportunities.
